page_convention: printed p -> PDF physical page p+1

engineering_choices.same_millisecond_order: a due interruption verdict precedes a report of the same millisecond
engineering_choices.double_vulnerability_cap: chances held plus triggers used never exceed two
engineering_choices.double_vulnerability_overlap: a second trigger inside a running 30 s period is rejected
engineering_choices.jammer_comparison: level(team) is the jammer on that team's radar base; marks are effective iff level(marked side) <= level(marker)
engineering_choices.jammer_saturation: a decode at level 3 changes nothing

not_implemented: information wave contents and key generation
